title: Compare remote access
responsibility: Identify the connected computer, phone and grant so views can react to access changes.

inputs.name: remoteAuthority.status
inputs.description: Remote status containing optional host, device and access grant.

inputs.name: authorityChange.known
inputs.description: Previously remembered holder and serialized grant.

inputs.name: authorityChange.steady
inputs.description: Whether the connection remained steady between these observations.

inputs.name: excludes.status
inputs.description: Status whose project grant is checked.

inputs.name: excludes.projectId
inputs.description: Project ID to check, or null for no selected project.

outputs.name: noAuthority
outputs.description: Initial authority with no holder and an empty grant.

outputs.name: remoteAuthority
outputs.description: Combined host/device identity and JSON serialization of the grant.

outputs.name: authorityChange
outputs.description: none for identical steady access; holder for a changed known holder; grant otherwise, including reconnection.

outputs.name: excludes
outputs.description: True when a non-null project is absent from the grant; false when no project is selected.
